sleep.title: Sleep Timer
sleep.desc: Set a listening limit. When time is up, audio gently fades out and stops, entering good-night mode so stories won't keep playing after your child falls asleep.

sleep.lockDesc: On: enters a good-night lock screen that needs the parent PIN to resume. Off: just stops; child can play again.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: Read Me To Sleep respects and protects your privacy:
privacy.b1: Story prompts are sent to our AI service; voice features upload recordings for speech recognition
privacy.b2: Sign-in is optional and only used to bind and restore membership across devices. No ads, no data selling
privacy.b3: Local data is erased when you delete the app; uploaded voice samples can be removed on request

and your membership and stories are still there.

perks.title: With a membership you get
perks.p1.title: Read in your own voice
perks.p1.desc: Record a short clip and the AI learns your voice — every story is then read to your child in your own voice.
perks.p2.title: As many stories as you like
perks.p2.desc: One story is never enough at bedtime — members have no daily limit.
perks.p3.title: A story for every place you go
perks.p3.desc: Travel check-ins turn city landmarks into their own stories — bedtime works on the road too.
perks.whyBodyApple:

After signing in, a new phone or a reinstall gets the membership back automatically — you never pay twice.

voices.title: Voice settings
voices.desc: Choose one voice for story reading and one for spoken prompts. Changes apply immediately — tap a voice to hear it.
voices.promptDesc: Used for questions, praise, status updates and AI answers.
voices.storyDesc: Used when reading the story itself. Cloning a voice switches this automatically.
voices.tip: Phone voice works offline and always speaks, but sounds robotic. Built-in voices sound more natural: the first use synthesizes once, then it is cached on this device.
voices.clonedDesc: Rename a cloned voice, or remove ones you no longer use. Renaming only changes the label — no re-cloning needed.
voices.renameSub: Currently called “{name}”. Type the name you would like to use.
voices.renameEmpty: The name can't be empty — even one character works!
voices.renameTooLong: Keep it to {n} characters or fewer so it stays easy to recognise.
voices.renameDuplicate: There is already a voice called “{name}”. Try another name.
voices.deleteConfirm: Once deleted, this voice can no longer be used on this device until you clone it again. Other voices are not affected.
